standard_prerequisites.name: Closed subschemes on affines
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies Z intersect D_+(T_i) with the closed subscheme of an ideal J_i of the chart ring.

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjective generated-in-degree-1 maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows Z prime = Proj of the quotient by I is a closed subscheme of projective space.

core_obligations: I = direct sum of the kernels is a graded ideal; Z prime = Proj of the quotient is a closed subscheme.
J prime (the chart ideal of Z prime) is generated by the fractions F/T_0^{deg(F)} with F in I; each vanishes on Z, so J prime is contained in J.
Conversely, for f in J of degree d, localize the equality of the chart ideals at T_i/T_0 to force T_0^{d_i} F into I for all i, hence T_0^{max(d_i)} F in I and f in J prime.
proof_roadmap: Set up the chart ideals, run the easy inclusion from vanishing of homogeneous forms, then reverse by localizing J and clearing denominators with powers of T_0.
difficulty_reason: Two-direction ideal comparison over standard affines with localization bookkeeping; fully displayed.
